card.name: The digit 3 or 6 starting a number
card.fires_on: The digit 3 (sometimes 6) at the start of a number, such as 30 or 360. It is strongest in infusion times ("over 30 minutes") and dose limits.

modes.label: Shorter infusion time
modes.description: The digit 3 in "30 minutes" for later infusions after a first, longer one.
